name: mojira
displayName: Mojira: a text browser for the GCC
description: Keyboard-first text browser over the giant connected component: lexicon entities, their relations, and the pending work that names them (M-mojira, 2026-11-10).

mojira.openOnStartup.description: Open the Mojira page when code-server starts.

enumDescriptions: Open files in Joe's Emacs with emacsclient (Mojira is a HUD beside Emacs).
Open files in the second editor column of code-server.

mojira.dailyLoopDir.description: Directory the daily-loop CLI runs in (bb daily-loop brief/verdict). Tests point a folder setting at a scratch copy.

mojira.bb.description: Babashka executable for the daily-loop CLI.

mojira.patternLibrary.description: The futon3 pattern library (.flexiarg files, one directory per family).

mojira.turnRecordsDir.description: The 象 turn records, read for the patterns proposed to each turn and 馬's verdicts. Read-only; Mojira caches a summary per record in ~/.cache/mojira.

mojira.cascadeDir.description: The recorded per-turn cascade to draw (occurrences.json, frame.json, verdict.md). Read directly until cascades have a GCC schema.

mojira.gccPreviewDir.description: GCC preview written by the projector (index.json, items/<id>.json; ~/notes/claude-13/demo-01-contract.md). While it is absent, the item view shows the invented fixture in test/gcc-preview-fixture.

mojira.loiDraft.description: Letter of intent draft, read only (fields marked <!-- field: NAME limit=N --> ... <!-- end -->).

mojira.loiNotes.description: File the b/p keys append benefit and beneficiary notes to. Empty: LOI-notes.md beside the draft.
